recipe.title: Moong Dal Khichdi Failsafe
recipe.description: Universal, easily digestible Khichdi that bypasses most constraints.

steps.text: Wash dal and rice together until water runs clear.
Heat ghee or oil in a pressure cooker. Add cumin seeds.
IF DAIRY ALLERGY OR VEGAN: Use neutral oil instead of Ghee before progressing.
Add turmeric, washed dal, rice, and salt. Sauté for 2 mins.
Add 6 cups of water. Pressure cook for 4 whistles.
FOR DADA (DIABETES): Remove 1 bowl before adding extra tadka (tempering).
Let pressure release naturally, mix well and serve warm.

recipe.validation: Cleared for Diabetes (portion control), Gluten Free, Nut Allergy. Needs oil sub for Dairy.
